name: Amazon Bedrock
description: AWS's serverless platform for foundation models from many providers: one endpoint over Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta, Mistral, Moonshot AI, MiniMax, Z.ai and xAI models, behind AWS credentials or a Bedrock API key.

authentication.notes: AWS credentials (Signature Version 4) or an Amazon Bedrock API key, sent as Authorization: Bearer. A second endpoint, https://bedrock-mantle.{region}.api.aws, serves the same OpenAI-compatible paths at /v1 plus Anthropic Messages at /anthropic/v1/messages. The OpenAI-compatible GET /models operation is not implemented; use ListFoundationModels and ListInferenceProfiles instead.
